scope: Backend-only visible storage ground and raw camera pixel regions; no world-state sensor projection
changes: Backend storage disk uses the existing zone anchor and radius with opaque unlit unfogged #00ff00; rings/beacons remain camera-hidden; old UI marker unchanged
Independent source-640x480 exact-chroma four-connected segmentation; inclusive bbox and pixelCount come only from RGBA bytes; clipping and occlusion are retained
Backend fallback package IDs use run-reset sequence; virtual-run telemetry and legacy vision helpers use simulation milliseconds instead of wall time
confidence_semantics: 1 means exact [0,255,0,255] chroma membership, not a fitted probability; identically colored unrelated pixels are possible ambiguities
